using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Auditing;
using Volo.Abp.Uow;
using Volo.Abp.Users;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.SignalR.Auditing;

[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]
public class AbpAuditHubFilterTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Call_GetRequiredService_IAuditingManager_In_ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var auditingManagerMock = new Mock<IAuditingManager>();
        var optionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>();
        var currentUserMock = new Mock<ICurrentUser>();
        var unitOfWorkManagerMock = new Mock<IUnitOfWorkManager>();
        var saveHandleMock = new Mock<IAuditingSaveHandle>();

        var auditingOptions = new AbpAuditingOptions
        {
            IsEnabled = true,
            IsEnabledForAnonymousUsers = true
        };

        optionsMock.Setup(o => o.Value).Returns(auditingOptions);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>())
            .Returns(optionsMock.Object);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ICurrentUser>())
            .Returns(currentUserMock.Object);

        // Setup the specific GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>() call we want to test (line ~101)
        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>())
            .Returns(auditingManagerMock.Object)
            .Verifiable();

        currentUserMock.Setup(c => c.IsAuthenticated).Returns(true);

        var auditLogInfo = new AuditLogInfo
        {
            Actions = { new AuditLogAction() }
        };

        auditingManagerMock.Setup(am => am.Current).Returns(new AuditingScope
        {
            Log = auditLogInfo
        });

        var invocationContext = new Mock<HubInvocationContext>(serviceProviderMock.Object, Array.Empty<object>(), "TestMethod", Array.Empty<object>());
        invocationContext.Setup(ic => ic.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProviderMock.Object);

        var filter = new AbpAuditHubFilter();

        // Act
        var nextDelegate = new Func<HubInvocationContext, ValueTask<object?>>(async ctx =>
        {
            return null;
        });

        await filter.InvokeMethodAsync(invocationContext.Object, nextDelegate);

        // Assert - Verify the specific GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>() call was made in ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>(), Times.AtLeastOnce());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync_Should_Call_GetRequiredService_IAuditingManager_And_Return_False_When_No_Actions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var auditingManagerMock = new Mock<IAuditingManager>();
        var optionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>();
        var currentUserMock = new Mock<ICurrentUser>();

        var auditingOptions = new AbpAuditingOptions
        {
            IsEnabled = true,
            IsEnabledForAnonymousUsers = true
        };

        optionsMock.Setup(o => o.Value).Returns(auditingOptions);
        currentUserMock.Setup(c => c.IsAuthenticated).Returns(true);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>())
            .Returns(optionsMock.Object);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ICurrentUser>())
            .Returns(currentUserMock.Object);

        // The specific call we want to test
        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>())
            .Returns(auditingManagerMock.Object);

        auditingManagerMock.Setup(am => am.Current).Returns((AuditingScope)null);

        var auditLogInfo = new AuditLogInfo();
        var filter = new AbpAuditHubFilter();

        // Act
        var result = await filter.ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync(auditLogInfo, serviceProviderMock.Object, false);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>(), Times.Once());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync_Should_Call_GetRequiredService_IAuditingManager_And_Return_True_When_Actions_Exist()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var auditingManagerMock = new Mock<IAuditingManager>();
        var optionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>();
        var currentUserMock = new Mock<ICurrentUser>();

        var auditingOptions = new AbpAuditingOptions
        {
            IsEnabled = true,
            IsEnabledForAnonymousUsers = true
        };

        optionsMock.Setup(o => o.Value).Returns(auditingOptions);
        currentUserMock.Setup(c => c.IsAuthenticated).Returns(true);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<AbpAuditingOptions>>())
            .Returns(optionsMock.Object);

        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ICurrentUser>())
            .Returns(currentUserMock.Object);

        // The specific call we want to test
        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>())
            .Returns(auditingManagerMock.Object);

        var auditLogInfo = new AuditLogInfo
        {
            Actions = { new AuditLogAction() }
        };

        auditingManagerMock.Setup(am => am.Current).Returns(new AuditingScope
        {
            Log = auditLogInfo
        });

        var filter = new AbpAuditHubFilter();

        // Act
        var result = await filter.ShouldWriteAuditLogAsync(auditLogInfo, serviceProviderMock.Object, false);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IAuditingManager>(), Times.Once());
    }
}
